# Multireligionvalsystem

> The Multi-Religion Election System (Multireligionvalsystem) proposes the Faith Representatives Chamber (FRC) — a democratically elected parallel parliament of all religious communities, modeled on the Nordic church election tradition and extended to all faiths.

## Key pages

- Anchor article (Israel-Palestine conflict resolution): https://www.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/multireligionvalsystem-anchor-article.html
- Main site: https://www.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/
- Faith Representatives Chamber: https://frc.multireligionvalsystem.eu.org/
